slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Rural clinics' aggregate health data is compiled on paper or Excel, submitted to locality offices and entered into the national DHIS2 at state and locality levels, on the compilation's reading of WHO's 2020 health information system assessment.

systems.tiers: state and locality levels; 76% locality coverage and 64% facility reporting rate as of 2020
local civil registry centres record on paper and transmit electronically to regional and central databases

note: An AI-assisted compilation by its own header, and an excluded source in study.json. The 'locality offices' are those receiving health reports: the document does not say they are the locality government's own office or how they are connected, so the two facts rest on entry into a national system at locality level and the parent should weigh them. The school, police and registry rows state nothing about local government offices. [parent, L3: an authorities fact withdrawn; see corrections.csv]
